narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Two bags only, one big bag from each farm!
<bookmark mark='weigh'/>Those bags would weigh eighty four and one hundred and eight kilograms.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>They are not equal, and equal bags are what she wants.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows two bags, one from each farm; the bags are weighed and the scale shows 84 kg and 108 kg, different; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>The heaviest equal bag is the highest common factor of the amounts. Divide each amount by it to count the bags.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Two farms give fifty six and seventy kilograms of rice. Find the heaviest equal bag and the number of bags.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line the heaviest equal bag is the highest common factor appears; then two new sacks, 56 kg and 70 kg, appear with two empty boxes
